# Memory

Dated notes the twin keeps for itself. It reads this before a recurring task - a
review, a triage, a call it has weighed before - so the next run starts from what the
last one learned, instead of from nothing.

Append-only. Newest at the bottom. One line each: date, what happened, the rule behind
it. Never rewrite or delete a line - a wrong call you can see beats a history you can't.

- 2026-08-24 - Blocked the Lantern index migration: it ran before the backfill and had no rollback path. persona.md #4.
- 2026-08-26 - Let a large diff through with one naming nit. Test-only and reversible, so not worth blocking. standards.md (what I leave alone).
- 2026-08-29 - Triaged the Fabrikam thread to needs-me: external, and it named a date I hadn't confirmed. voice.md (external = no unconfirmed dates).
